title: Sha'arei Orah (Hebrew, Italian manuscript)
author: Joseph Gikatilla
description: Sha'arei Orah (Gates of Light) by Rabbi Joseph Gikatilla (1248-c. 1305), the Castilian Kabbalist and disciple of Abraham Abulafia, here in a Hebrew manuscript copy of Italian origin. Written in the late thirteenth century, it is one of the most important and clearest introductions to the theory of the ten sefirot. Its ten 'gates' each correspond to a sefirah, moving upward from Malkhut (Kingdom, the Shekhinah) to Keter (Crown), and explain the many biblical divine names and epithets associated with each, so that the reader can understand the scriptural text and prayer as a map of the divine structure. It became a standard primer of Kabbalah, was translated into Latin by Paulus Ricius in 1516 (Portae Lucis), influencing Christian Kabbalah, and is still widely studied. The scan of the manuscript is difficult to read by OCR.
